Originally belonged to Rebecca from David Martinez's crew. It'll wreak bloody havoc, though it can be a little unpredictable. Much like its original owner.

Category: One of a kind. (Super Luxury) • Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Shotgun • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: N/A

Damage: N/A • Capacity: 6 (Shell Only) • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Shotgun Shell (4d6)

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild, Shotgun Rechamber • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Shotgun Shells. When rolling for damage with this weapon, 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring a Critical Injury. Whenever this weapon would ablate armor, it ablates an additional 2 points of SP (3 SP total). Whenever this weapon incurs a Critical Injury, the user rolls thrice on the Critical Injury table until they roll three Critical Injuries that aren’t Foreign Object, and then chooses two of them for the victim to suffer. The victim only suffers the Bonus Damage from one of the selected Critical Injuries.

Whenever this weapon puts a living target into the Mortally Wounded Wound State, for the rest of that combat encounter, it deals 1d6 additional damage with Shotgun Shells. This can stack multiple times, to a maximum of three Mortally Wounded targets (i.e., 5d6 at 1 Target, 6d6 at 2, and 7d6 at 3). Once combat ends or this weapon fires a Shotgun Shell at 7d6 damage, whichever comes first, this effect is reset and the weapon returns to its default damage level and features.

Requires BODY 10+ or paired Cyberarms to not send the user 2m/yds backwards and cause the Broken Arm Critical Injury when fired. If this weapon’s user fires it beneath them as a ROF 1 Attack Action while Jumping or Climbing, they are moved an additional 2m/yds in a direction of their choice (including straight up). While wielded, this weapon reduces the user’s MOVE by 2 (Minimum 4).

Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month
Range: N/A
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, Shotgun Rechamber (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell (4d6)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
